purpose: Test whether the Phase 2 absolute-inflation interaction has allocation-layer value when applied as a frozen Treasury-to-cash overlay on the existing #89 3x3 policy, using underlying annual returns only.
frozen_research_boundaries: Do not modify V6.6 or HMRA-v0.1.
Do not modify the #89 base 3x3 Growth x Inflation allocation matrix.
Do not change the absolute-inflation threshold from 4% after viewing outcomes.
Do not add COVID-, rate-level-, real-yield-, term-premium-, or stock-bond-correlation rules inside Issue #95.
Do not promote a production allocator from this reused-history study.

sample_and_timing.overlay_inflation_observation: HMRA state-year t December-to-December CPI inflation

overlay_rule.operation_order: Select the frozen base 3x3 Equity/Treasury/Gold template first, then redirect the frozen fraction of the Treasury sleeve to cash.

formula.treasury_weight: base_treasury_weight * (1 - redirect_fraction) when active; otherwise base_treasury_weight

overlay_rule.rationale: Phase 2 found the cleanest higher-order interaction in Treasury-minus-cash under >=4% absolute inflation. A 50% Treasury-sleeve redirect is the neutral preregistered primary haircut, not an optimized size.

rebalancing_and_costs.rebalance_timing: At the start of each evaluated return year using the frozen t -> t+2 information mapping.

required_strategies_and_controls.primary_overlay: Frozen #89 base matrix + 4% inflation activation + 50% Treasury-sleeve redirect to cash.
required_strategies_and_controls.base_policy_no_overlay: Frozen #89 base 3x3 policy on underlying Equity/Treasury/Gold.

causal_inverse_vol.design_requirement: Must use only returns observable before each evaluated return year under the same annual information discipline.
causal_inverse_vol.fallback_if_not_feasible: Document exclusion; do not replace with a noncausal version.

realized_exposure_matched_static_control.target: Match the primary overlay strategy's realized average invested weights over the exact evaluation sample.
realized_exposure_matched_static_control.interpretation: Overlay-vs-matched-static residual is switching/timing value; overlay-vs-base alone mixes switching with average cash exposure.

temporal_validation.recent_era_rescue_guard: If material positive overlay value is confined to 2020-2025 and does not appear in the earlier high-inflation era, classify as recent_era_rescue_only.

leave_one_era_out.procedure: For the primary 50% overlay, omit each predeclared return-year era and fully rerun allocations, turnover, costs, realized-exposure matched static control, and active metrics.

episode_concentration.activation_episode_definition: Contiguous evaluated return years for which the lagged HMRA state-year inflation is >=4%.
episode_concentration.leaveout_procedure: Remove the entire largest positive active episode and fully rerun the overlay, base, costs, and matched-static control on the remaining sample.

forbidden: selecting a sensitivity as the new primary because it performs better

verdict_rules.robust_inflation_conditioned_switching_v: Primary 50% overlay adds material switching/timing value versus the realized-exposure-matched static control, is not dominated by one active episode, and shows evidence across more than one historical inflation era including evidence outside 2020-2025.
verdict_rules.historical_risk_management_value_only: Primary overlay does not show robust return/Sharpe switching value versus matched static, but materially and non-fragilely improves downside/max-drawdown behavior across historical inflation episodes.
verdict_rules.recent_era_rescue_only: Positive primary overlay value is concentrated in 2020-2025 and is not supported by the earlier high-inflation era 1975-1984.
verdict_rules.allocation_mix_only_no_switching_value: Overlay beats the base policy but does not materially beat its realized-exposure-matched static control; benefit is attributable to average asset mix rather than regime timing.
verdict_rules.no_material_overlay_value: Primary overlay does not add material return, risk-management, or matched-static switching value after costs.
verdict_rules.inconclusive_insufficient_evidence: Sparse active years, unstable attribution, conflicting robustness checks, or episode concentration prevents a defensible category.

interpretation_guards: Beating the base #89 policy is not sufficient evidence.
Matched-static residual is required to claim switching value.
Diagnostic 25%/75% overlay results cannot replace the primary 50% verdict.
A 2020-2025-only gain is not robust long-history evidence.
Any successful result remains reused historical evidence, not untouched OOS.
No production change is authorized by this issue.
order_of_operations: CI confirms no Phase 3 outcome implementation or decision exists.
Generate matched-static attribution, temporal validation, leave-one-era-out and episode concentration.
Run diagnostics 25/75 redirect and 0/10bp costs without changing primary.
Keep PR Draft/Open/unmerged unless explicitly authorized.
